big_case.notes: Second emergency round over FCC lowest-unit-charge treatment of party coordinated ad buys weeks before the 2026 midterms, following this Court's September stay in the same dispute. Nationally relevant to campaign spending, but the Court disposed of it as moot in a short per curiam (two Justices would have denied outright), so it set no new interim-relief doctrine; the vehicle was procedural (mandamus compelling agency action).

leakage.notes: Forward cell (log mode forward, result_capture_coverage 0.0 - every call unobserved). Calls include a CourtListener docket lookup for 26A477, a docket search by caption, and a web search '"26A477" "Supreme Court"' run on 2026-10-14, the same date the application was denied as moot; results unobserved, so whether the denial had surfaced cannot be determined (retrieved_outcome_material left null). The prose cites an Oct. 8 administrative stay (a pre-resolution fact the response brief corroborates) and treats the application as pending; it predicts granted, opposite the outcome, so the result plausibly did not shape the forecast.
